authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10978 lavaṇa explicitly gives Niṅg. lõ and regional lūṇ/lōn salt. Nasalized lõ/lū̃ fit contraction of this salt word; bare Gujari nu requires confirming nasal loss rather than relying on the old match. Exact survey form lõ is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9964 mahiṣa explicitly gives maīś/mẽṣ/maĩś and regional bhẽs buffalo. These sibilant-bearing variants fit the buffalo family; very reduced me and unexplained bhās remain separate review cases. Exact survey form maīś is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
